newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed futures fall in limited trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed futures fall in limited trade.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery lost 4.50/5.50 rupees to 1,144.50 rupees per quintal on Monday on continued speculative selling, dealers said.
They said trading was dull in the absence of export enquiries.
In edible oils, groundnut oil lost one rupee to 371 per 10 kgs. In Rajkot, it was quoted nine rupees higher at 564 rupees per 15 kg on limited arrivals.
Imported palm oil gained two rupees to 297 rupees per 10 kg.
Dealers said they would expect some marginal fall in palm oil prices following the arrival of a ship carrying 4,500 tonnes of palm oil at Bombay port.
